title: Extend react_ui/src/api/client.ts with memory management API functions
description:
Extend react_ui/src/api/client.ts with typed API functions for the memory management endpoints defined in chatbot/api/memory.py (task b.7).

Add TypeScript functions that call the following endpoints using the existing fetchApi wrapper pattern from the client:
- getMemories(companionId, pagination, privacyFilter)
- toggleMemoryPin(memoryId, pinned)
- deleteMemory(memoryId)
- updateMemory(memoryId, data)
- setMemoryPrivacy(memoryId, privacyLevel)
- doNotRemember(memoryId)
- rememberForever(memoryId)
- correctMemory(memoryId, correction)
- searchMemories(query, filters)
- exportMemories(filters, format)
- getMemoryProvenance(memoryId)

Define TypeScript interfaces/types for request bodies and response shapes. Match the API contract from the FastAPI router.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- react_ui/src/api/client.ts for the existing fetchApi pattern, type imports, and function conventions
- react_ui/src/types/ for existing type definitions
- chatbot/api/memory.py for the exact endpoint paths, methods, and request/response shapes

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

SINGLE-OWNER FILE: react_ui/src/api/client.ts is owned exclusively by this task in this phase. No other task may modify it.
acceptance_criteria: react_ui/src/api/client.ts includes memory API functions matching the endpoint list
All functions use the existing fetchApi wrapper pattern
TypeScript interfaces/types are defined for memory API request/response shapes
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends
